title: The Debt of Vienna
author: E. M. Pemberton
blurb: Jonah Thackeray, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
